projects.title: NIKHIL//OS
projects.summary: An AI-native personal computing environment — a Unix-inspired operating system that runs in the browser.
projects.description: A portfolio that behaves like a real OS: a Rust core compiled to WebAssembly with a process manager, round-robin scheduler, virtual filesystem, typed IPC, service manager, package manager, and a shell with real pipelines — all wrapped in a React desktop environment. This repository.
projects.architecture: Rust core → WASM bridge → React desktop. The UI is a surface over observable core state; no telemetry is faked.
highlights: Simulated OS core with processes, scheduler, VFS, IPC, syscalls
nish shell with pipes, redirection, aliases, history, autocomplete
Live /proc and /sys virtual filesystems backed by real runtime state
Compiled to WASM; same core targets the future Tauri desktop edition
